content: If the Dem module is requested to support combination on stor- age, the DTC status bit transitions of the combined DTC (refer [SWS_Dem_00441]) shall be used as trigger source for the allocation of the event memory entry , as well as the collection or update of its related data (freeze frames or extended data records).
